comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - illustrates the conditionalAccessPolicies shape and mandatory safety fields.

break-glass group id passed to New-CaCExtendedPlan/-Test-CaCExtendedConfiguration, or the
plan will report this policy as Blocked rather than Create/Update. Not a real tenant scenario.
